page.title: About
page.metaDescription: Thibaut Gendebien — independent consulting practice based in the Benelux, dedicated to NetSuite and to AI in business operations.

hero.lede: Independent consultant. More than ten years turning ERPs into tools that operations actually use, and wiring AI into them without losing sight of the floor.

paragraphs: TG Tech Consulting was founded to give Benelux organisations what often goes missing in the NetSuite landscape: a counterpart who codes, who understands operations, and who isn’t afraid to say ‘this isn’t the right approach’.

The practice rests on two convictions. The first: an ERP only earns its keep when it is inhabited — used, understood, owned by the business teams. The second: AI only earns its keep when it is wired into real processes, not displayed as a gimmick.
The format is intentionally tight: focused engagements, close deliveries, no smokescreens. A bet on quality over volume.

items.label: I
items.title: ERP depth
items.body: More than ten years inside NetSuite. SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteAnalytics, SuiteCloud Development Framework. The technical layer is not negotiated — it is mastered.

items.label: II
items.title: Deliver what gets used
items.body: A project that sleeps in a sandbox is not a success. The metric that counts: how many teams open the tool every Monday morning without flinching.

items.label: III
items.title: Direct communication
items.body: No empty jargon, no cosmetic decks. A weekly note that says what works, what frustrates, and what we ship next week.

cta.lede: An hour offered to understand your context before any quote.

page.metaDescription: TG Tech Consulting privacy policy — data collected, GA4, processors, GDPR rights.

privacy.intro: This page describes how TG Tech Consulting processes data collected via the tgtechconsulting.com website.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: TG Tech Consulting — to be completed with registered company name, BCE/CBE number, registered office address, contact reference.

sections.title: Data collected
sections.body: Anonymous visit metrics via Vercel Analytics (cookieless). On explicit consent, audience statistics via Google Analytics 4 (page views, traffic source, session duration). Temporary technical logs on the host side (IP address, user agent) for security purposes.

sections.title: Purposes
sections.body: Measure site audience, identify useful content, prevent technical abuse. No commercial profiling, no resale, no advertising.

sections.title: Legal bases
sections.body: Explicit consent for Google Analytics 4 (article 6.1.a GDPR). Legitimate interest for Vercel Analytics and technical logs (article 6.1.f GDPR).

sections.title: Retention periods
sections.body: GA4: default duration set to 14 months. Vercel Analytics: continuous aggregation, no identifying data. Technical logs: 30 days maximum.

sections.title: Processors
sections.body: Vercel Inc. (hosting and analytics) — United States, under standard contractual clauses. Google Ireland Ltd. (Google Analytics 4) — on consent only.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Access, rectification, erasure, portability, objection, withdrawal of consent. Complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority. Contact: use the site email address.
